evals.prompt: Validate a rollout to the public mcpruntime.org k3s cluster using the repo deployment scripts.
evals.expected_output: Use production-operations guidance, rebuild the CLI, validate image refs/pull secrets, and run health checks.
assertions: Selects canonical deploy scripts and k3s-specific checks.
Requires cluster doctor and rollout health evidence.

evals.prompt: My local Kind cluster has a dashboard 401 in test mode.
evals.expected_output: Route to local-dev or troubleshooting guidance, not public k3s operations.
assertions: Does not suggest public deployment commands.
Routes to the appropriate local troubleshooting skill.

evals.prompt: The Staging E2E (Remote Cluster) workflow failed at setup with an x509 error pulling the operator image; rerun it and fix the failure.
evals.expected_output: Use the Staging E2E runbook: open summary.md and the failed stage log, check staging roots/node trust, rerun only against the disposable VM behind the target guard.
assertions: Keeps the run on the disposable *.e2e.mcpruntime.org VM and never targets the production cluster.
Does not create or bypass the DISPOSABLE marker without the explicit bootstrap step.
Starts triage from the first failed stage in summary.md and its stage log.
